dynamic_evidence.before: unittest.loader._FailedTest caused by NameError: name 'dataclass' is not defined
dynamic_evidence.after: Ran 34 tests with downstream functional failures/errors

root_cause: The effect classifier compared raw error counts across different diagnostic surfaces.
Removing an import barrier legitimately expands verifier coverage and may increase the visible residual count.
The classifier lacked a positive proof that previously unreachable tests actually executed.

behavior: Classify Python import-barrier removal as forward_unmask only when the before evidence contains unittest.loader._FailedTest or failed-to-import-test-module.
Require the barrier to disappear and the after evidence to prove that at least one test ran.
Keep exception churn without real test execution classified as regression.

residual_risk: A later canonical TaskRuntime settlement may still need reconciliation if forward_unmask is recorded as a failed terminal task even though subsequent QA repair converges. This must be proven dynamically before changing settlement semantics.
